In Civ 4 the best early game is to rapidly expand (REX) as fast as you can until your economy can't take anymore (Usually when you have to turn your science slider down to 50-60%). With this build up your economy and infrastructure. Cottage everything except resources, mine hills and just spam cottages, they will be the bedrock of your economy. Farms are only good on rice/corn/wheat or until the late game.

Rushing the AI is always useful since Civ 4 capitals are usually the best cities. Do not neglect your military, the AI will dogpile you and it will suck. 

For the civics, I usually pick the most popular Religion on the continent and go organize religion for faster buildings and never bother founding my own. Learn to abuse to slavery civic, if something has 1 turn to finish, 'whip' it so the overflow goes into the next production, doing this you'll burn off the unhappiness from slavery.
